project: Wuxia Life v1.0 Release Candidate And Launch Readiness
description: Complete a launch-readiness transition from phase-style expansion to a bounded v1.0 release-candidate workflow by auditing current launch surfaces, defining shipping and freeze rules, extending profile-first RC reporting surfaces, establishing first-run and full-life acceptance baselines, shipping representative RC comparison and blocker-fix samples, producing a machine-readable validation matrix, and closing with an evidence-backed v1.0 RC gate and post-launch cadence definition without starting a new large systems phase.

userStories.title: Audit current v1.0 launch surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of current launch-facing experience surfaces so that v1.0 work targets real release blockers instead of open-ended optimization.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit current launch surfaces across first-run quality, replay value, route clarity, mid/late payoff, legacy or endgame quality, technical stability, and report health
Classify each audited surface as launch-ready, borderline, or release-blocking
Record the main risks that could prevent a clean v1.0 launch
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Define launch dimensions in scope
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want the v1.0 launch dimensions defined explicitly so that RC decisions are judged against a stable shipping model.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the required launch dimensions in scope for v1.0
Explain how first-run, replay, route readability, payoff, ending quality, and technical stability contribute to launch readiness
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Define blocker and deferral rules
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want explicit blocker and deferral rules so that v1.0 triage does not drift back into phase-style ambition.
acceptanceCriteria: Define what counts as a release blocker, a launch-quality issue, and a post-launch candidate issue
Define which classes of work are explicitly deferred to post-launch patches or content waves
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Define v1.0 freeze boundary
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want a launch-freeze boundary defined so that RC work stays bounded and predictable.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the launch-freeze boundary for v1.0

Save the freeze definition under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Define alignment indicator set
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a stable internal-to-external alignment indicator set so that release decisions do not over-trust internal acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: Define 3-5 representative alignment indicators across onboarding clarity, replay desire, route readability, payoff strength, and ending aftertaste
Ensure each indicator has a concrete use in deciding whether a build is ready, blocked, or patch-worthy
Ensure the indicator set is suitable for future RC and post-launch comparison
Save the definition under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not require runtime redesign in this story
